scope: Exact-head UX, native editor, procedural knob, modulation, accessibility, and GPU capture verification.

focused_tests.command: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Grainfield (clean-room panel scaffold|knob skin|native editor|explicit GPU|procedural knob|right-click|leaves geometry|modulation context|bound editor knob)' --output-on-failure

gpu_capture.command: GRAINFIELD_GPU_CAPTURE_PROBE=1 GRAINFIELD_GPU_CAPTURE_OUTPUT=build/grainfield-gpu-capture.png ./build/Grainfield-editor-test 'Grainfield explicit GPU capture reports its actual backend' --reporter console

ux_coverage.procedural_knobs: pass; deterministic segmented black annulus, off-white cap, broad pointer, and mapped DXF diameter
ux_coverage.host_automation: pass; bound editor knob emits a host automation gesture
ux_coverage.contextual_lfo: pass; right-click target, enable/disable, rate/depth adjustment, and reset
ux_coverage.accessibility: pass; provisional controls expose disabled state and explicit provisional labels
ux_coverage.provisional_controls: 19 geometry-only controls remain visible and disabled pending authoritative semantics

open_fidelity_gates: Rights-cleared straight-on Beads reference or explicit permission/share-alike decision
Authoritative label-to-DXF/component mapping for the 19 provisional controls
Exact-head pixel/geometry comparison against a rights-cleared reference
Exact-head release acceptance for procedural knob appearance
rights_boundary: No Beads panel artwork, AI/PDF/CAD source, logos, or reference photos are redistributed by this receipt.
release_claim: UX behavior and GPU path are proven at this exact head; Beads visual fidelity and rights clearance remain unproven.
